title.zh: 由 1D 与 2D NMR 推出 C_{10}H_{16}O 的结构

prompt.zh: 在 CDCl_{3} 中（500 MHz，298 K）测得 ^{1}H、^{13}C、DEPT-135、HSQC 和 HMBC。推出结构并归属每一个峰。
prompt.en: ^{1}H, ^{13}C, DEPT-135, HSQC and HMBC in CDCl_{3} (500 MHz, 298 K). Deduce the structure and assign every peak.

note.zh: 全部位移、DEPT 相位、HSQC 和 HMBC 峰都取自 BMRB 公开的实测峰表。J 值是按该记录给出的谱线位置换算的。该记录做过 COSY 但没有公布峰表，所以这里不画 COSY。
note.en: Every shift, DEPT phase, HSQC and HMBC peak is taken from the measured peak lists published by BMRB. J values are computed from the line positions in that record. The record includes a COSY experiment but no COSY peak list, so no COSY is drawn here.

answer.zh: 答案：5-甲基-2-(丙-2-亚基)环己酮（胡薄荷酮）。所测样品是 (+)-(R)-胡薄荷酮，但 NMR 分不出对映体。
answer.en: Answer: 5-methyl-2-(propan-2-ylidene)cyclohexan-1-one (pulegone). The sample measured is (+)-(R)-pulegone, but NMR cannot tell enantiomers apart.

sources.label: BMRB metabolomics entry bmse000839, (+)-pulegone (Bruker DMX 500 MHz, 100 mM in CDCl3, 298 K, TMS; National Magnetic Resonance Facility at Madison). doi:10.13018/BMSE000839

covers.en: Measured: shift, shape and integral of the nine ^{1}H peaks (2.714 m 1, 2.494 m 1, 2.252 t 1, 2.020 m 1, 1.976 s 3, 1.869 m 1, 1.777 s 3, 1.329 m 1, 1.003 d 3) and the positions of 43 lines; ten ^{13}C shifts (204.437, 141.836, 131.891, 50.897, 32.826, 31.659, 28.668, 23.030, 22.120, 21.803); DEPT-90 (31.648) and the DEPT-135 phases; 10 HSQC peaks; 8 HMBC peaks. This page uses p-menthane numbering; BMRB atom names map as C10→C3, C9→C4, C7→C8, C6→C2, C8→C1, C4→C6, C5→C5, C3→C7, C1/C2→C9/C10. The record leaves open which isopropylidene methyl is C9 and which is C10.

rule.zh: 每个双键或环算 1。氧不影响不饱和度。
rule.en: Each double bond or ring counts 1. Oxygen does not change the count.

so.zh: 一共 3 个双键或环，可能是 C=O、C=C 和环的某种组合。
so.en: Three double bonds or rings in total, some combination of C=O, C=C and rings.

check.zh: 单靠分子式分不出是哪种组合，要看碳谱。
check.en: The formula alone cannot say which combination, so look at the carbon spectrum next.

title.zh: 碳谱加 DEPT：10 个碳，16 个 H
title.en: Carbon spectrum with DEPT: 10 carbons, 16 H

ask.en: Ten carbon peaks. In DEPT-135, 50.9, 32.8 and 28.7 point down; 31.7, 23.0, 22.1 and 21.8 point up; DEPT-90 keeps only 31.7. What is each carbon?

text.en: Ten peaks for ten carbons. 204.4, 141.8 and 131.9 do not appear in DEPT.

rule.zh: DEPT-135：CH_{2} 朝下，CH 和 CH_{3} 朝上；DEPT-90 只显示 CH；不带 H 的碳在 DEPT 里消失。
rule.en: DEPT-135: CH_{2} points down, CH and CH_{3} point up; DEPT-90 shows only CH; carbons without H vanish in DEPT.

so.zh: 3 个季碳、1 个 CH、3 个 CH_{2}、3 个 CH_{3}：0 + 1 + 6 + 9 = 16 H，正好等于分子式。没有 O–H。
so.en: Three quaternary C, one CH, three CH_{2}, three CH_{3}: 0 + 1 + 6 + 9 = 16 H, exactly the formula. There is no O–H.

check.zh: 31.7 在 DEPT-90 里出现，所以它是 CH，不是 CH_{3}。
check.en: 31.7 survives in DEPT-90, so it is a CH, not a CH_{3}.

title.en: 204.4, 141.8, 131.9: a C=O and a tetrasubstituted C=C

text.en: One peak at 204.4 and a pair at 141.8 and 131.9, none of them carrying H.

rule.zh: 酮的 C=O 在 195–215 ppm；烯碳在 100–150 ppm。
rule.en: A ketone C=O lies at 195–215 ppm; alkene carbons at 100–150 ppm.

so.zh: 一个酮羰基，一个 C=C，C=C 的两端都没有 H（四取代）。三个不饱和度用掉两个，剩下一个只能是环。
so.en: One ketone carbonyl and one C=C whose two ends carry no H (tetrasubstituted). That uses two of the three degrees of unsaturation, so the third must be a ring.

check.zh: 两个烯碳相差 10 ppm，说明 C=C 两端环境不同，比如一端接着 C=O。这一点后面用 HMBC 验证。
check.en: The two alkene carbons differ by 10 ppm, so the two ends are in different environments, for example one end next to the C=O. HMBC will test this later.

title.zh: 氢谱积分：只数到 15 个 H

ask.zh: 积分 1 : 1 : 1 : 1 : 3 : 1 : 3 : 1 : 3，加起来是多少？和分子式比一比。
ask.en: Integrals 1 : 1 : 1 : 1 : 3 : 1 : 3 : 1 : 3. What is the total? Compare it with the formula.

text.zh: 9 个峰，积分加起来 15H，分子式却有 16 个 H。
text.en: Nine peaks whose integrals add up to 15H, while the formula has 16 H.

rule.zh: 积分比例要和分子式对上。少了的 H 通常是被别的峰盖住了，或者是交换掉的 OH/NH。
rule.en: Integrals must add up to the formula. A missing H is usually hidden under another peak, or is an exchanged OH/NH.

so.zh: 有 1 个 H 藏在某个峰下面。碳谱已经说明没有 OH，所以它一定是被重叠盖住的 C–H。
so.en: One H is hidden under another peak. The carbon count already ruled out an OH, so it must be a C–H covered by overlap.

check.zh: 先记住这个缺口，HSQC 会把它找出来。
check.en: Keep this gap in mind; HSQC will find it.

text.en: δ 1.003, 3H, doublet. Its two lines sit at 1.009 and 0.997 ppm, 0.012 ppm apart.

rule.zh: n+1 规则：双峰说明邻碳上只有 1 个 H。饱和碳上的 CH_{3} 在 0.8–1.2 ppm，^{3}J 约 6–7 Hz。
rule.en: n+1 rule: a doublet means exactly one H on the neighbouring carbon. A CH_{3} on saturated carbon appears at 0.8–1.2 ppm with ^{3}J of about 6–7 Hz.

so.zh: 片段：CH_{3}–CH，而这个 CH 就是碳谱里唯一的 CH（31.7）。
so.en: Fragment: CH_{3}–CH, and that CH is the only CH in the carbon spectrum (31.7).

check.zh: J 是按 BMRB 给出的两条谱线位置算的，不是来源直接写的数值。
check.en: J is computed from the two line positions BMRB lists; the record does not state it as a number.

title.zh: 1.976 和 1.777 两个单峰：烯丙位甲基

rule.zh: 单峰说明相邻碳上没有 H。接在 C=C 上的甲基在 1.6–2.1 ppm，比饱和碳上的甲基低场。
rule.en: A singlet means no H on the neighbouring carbon. A methyl on a C=C appears at 1.6–2.1 ppm, downfield of a methyl on saturated carbon.

so.zh: 两个甲基都接在不带 H 的碳上，位移指向 C=C 的碳。
so.en: Both methyls sit on carbons without H, and the shifts point to carbons of the C=C.

check.zh: 另一个可能是接在 C=O 上（甲基酮约 2.1–2.2 ppm）。要用 HMBC 判断。
check.en: Another option would be a methyl on the C=O (a methyl ketone, about 2.1–2.2 ppm). HMBC will decide.

ask.zh: 1.98 附近有两个 HSQC 峰。它们分别连在哪个碳上？
ask.en: There are two HSQC peaks near 1.98. Which carbons are they on?

text.zh: δ_{H} 1.977 与 31.7（CH）相关，δ_{H} 1.975 与 23.0（CH_{3}）相关。两个 H 的位移几乎一样。
text.en: δ_{H} 1.977 correlates with 31.7 (the CH) and δ_{H} 1.975 with 23.0 (a CH_{3}). The two proton shifts are almost identical.

rule.zh: HSQC 只显示直接相连的 C–H（一键）。在氢谱里重叠的两个 H，只要连在不同碳上，HSQC 就能把它们分开。
rule.en: HSQC shows only directly bonded C–H pairs (one bond). Two protons that overlap in the proton spectrum are separated by HSQC if they sit on different carbons.

so.zh: 缺的那个 H 是 CH（31.7）上的 H，藏在 1.976 的甲基单峰下面。现在 16 个 H 都找到了。
so.en: The missing H is the one on the CH (31.7), hidden under the methyl singlet at 1.976. All 16 H are now found.

check.zh: 这就是第 4 步积分少 1 的原因：1.976 那个峰其实是 3H + 1H。
check.en: This explains the integral gap in step 4: the peak at 1.976 is really 3H + 1H.

title.zh: HSQC：三个 CH_{2}，每个两种 H
title.en: HSQC: three CH_{2}, each with two different H

text.en: 50.9 carries 2.50 and 2.00; 32.8 carries 1.87 and 1.33; 28.7 carries 2.71 and 2.25.

rule.zh: 同一个 CH_{2} 上的两个 H 位移不同，叫非对映异位。分子里有手性中心、又在环上时最常见。
rule.en: When the two H of one CH_{2} have different shifts they are diastereotopic. This is most common in a ring that contains a stereocentre.

so.zh: 三个 CH_{2} 很可能都在环上，而 CH(CH_{3}) 是那个手性中心。
so.en: The three CH_{2} groups are probably all in the ring, and the CH(CH_{3}) is the stereocentre.

check.zh: 50.9 的 CH_{2} 碳和它的 H（2.0–2.5）都偏低场，符合 C=O 旁边的 CH_{2}。
check.en: The CH_{2} at 50.9 and its protons (2.0–2.5) are both downfield, as expected for a CH_{2} next to a C=O.

title.zh: HMBC：从 CH_{3} 双峰看出去
title.en: HMBC: looking out from the CH_{3} doublet

text.en: δ_{H} 1.00 correlates with three carbons: 31.7, 32.8 and 50.9.

rule.zh: HMBC 主要显示隔 2 个或 3 个键的 C–H。CH_{3}–C 上的 H：2 键到它所连的碳，3 键到再隔一个的碳。
rule.en: HMBC mainly shows C–H pairs two or three bonds apart. For the H of CH_{3}–C: two bonds to the carbon it sits on, three bonds to that carbon's neighbours.

so.en: H7 to C1 (31.7) is two bonds; 32.8 and 50.9 are three bonds, so C1 is flanked by these two CH_{2}. Fragment: CH_{2}(32.8)–CH(CH_{3})–CH_{2}(50.9).

title.zh: HMBC：甲基 1.777 接在 C=C 上
title.en: HMBC: the 1.777 methyl sits on the C=C

ask.zh: 1.777 的甲基同时看到 141.9 和 131.8。它接在哪个碳上？
ask.en: The 1.777 methyl sees both 141.9 and 131.8. Which carbon is it attached to?

text.en: δ_{H} 1.777 correlates with both 141.9 and 131.8, and not with 204.4.

rule.zh: 甲基 H 到所连碳 2 键，到下一个碳 3 键。两个烯碳都出现，说明甲基接在其中一个烯碳上，另一个隔一个键。
rule.en: A methyl H is two bonds from its carbon and three from the next. Seeing both alkene carbons means the methyl sits on one of them, with the other one bond further away.

so.zh: 甲基接在 C=C 上，排除了甲基酮。片段：CH_{3}–C=C。
so.en: The methyl is on the C=C, which rules out a methyl ketone. Fragment: CH_{3}–C=C.

check.zh: 另一个甲基（1.976）和 H1 重叠，记录里没有它的 HMBC 峰。它也是单峰、也在烯丙位，又只剩烯碳可接，所以按 (CH_{3})_{2}C= 处理。两个甲基哪个是 C9、哪个是 C10，这些数据定不了。
check.en: The other methyl (1.976) overlaps with H1, and the record lists no HMBC peak for it. It is also a singlet in the allylic range, and only an alkene carbon is left for it, so treat the unit as (CH_{3})_{2}C=. Which methyl is C9 and which C10 cannot be settled from these data.

title.en: HMBC: the ring CH_{2} (28.7) joins the C=C

rule.zh: CH_{2} 接在烯碳上时，H 到这个烯碳 2 键，到另一端烯碳 3 键。
rule.en: When a CH_{2} is attached to an alkene carbon, its H is two bonds from that carbon and three from the far alkene carbon.

so.en: The CH_{2} at 28.7 is bonded to 131.8 (C4), and 141.8 is the far end (C8) carrying the two methyls. Fragment: CH_{2}–C4=C8(CH_{3})_{2}.

check.zh: 这和上一步一致：甲基到 C8 是 2 键，到 C4 是 3 键。
check.en: This agrees with the previous step: the methyl is two bonds from C8 and three from C4.

rule.zh: HMBC 一般到 3 键为止。H 到 C4 是 3 键，说明中间只隔一个碳。
rule.en: HMBC usually reaches three bonds. Three bonds from this H to C4 means exactly one carbon lies between them.

so.en: The carbon between them is C5 (28.7). The chain now reads C4–C5H_{2}–C6H_{2}–C1H(CH_{3})–C2H_{2}.

check.zh: 这一步用的是 HMBC，不是 COSY。COSY 本来能直接看到 H5/H6 相邻，但这条记录没有给出 COSY 峰表。
check.en: This step uses HMBC, not COSY. COSY would show the H5/H6 neighbours directly, but this record gives no COSY peak list.

title.zh: 合环：C=O 放在 C2 和 C4 之间
title.en: Closing the ring: the C=O goes between C2 and C4

text.zh: 只剩下 204.4 的 C=O 没有接上。链的两个空端是 C2（50.9）和 C4（131.9）。
text.en: Only the C=O at 204.4 is still unattached. The two open ends of the chain are C2 (50.9) and C4 (131.9).

rule.zh: 第 3 个不饱和度是一个环。C=O 接在两个空端之间就合成六元环。
rule.en: The third degree of unsaturation is a ring. Placing the C=O between the two open ends closes a six-membered ring.

so.zh: 环己酮，C2 位是 CH_{2}，C4 位是异丙亚基，和 C=O 共轭。
so.en: A cyclohexanone with CH_{2} at C2 and an isopropylidene at C4, conjugated with the C=O.

check.zh: C2 的碳（50.9）和 H（2.00、2.50）都在 C=O 旁的范围里，符合。两个烯碳差 10 ppm 也说得通：远离 C=O 的 C8 在低场。不过记录里没有 H2 到 C=O 的 HMBC 峰，这一连接是靠排除法得出的。
check.en: C2 (50.9) and its protons (2.00, 2.50) fall in the range for a CH_{2} next to a C=O, as expected. The 10 ppm gap between the alkene carbons also fits: C8, away from the C=O, is downfield. However the record lists no HMBC peak from H2 to the C=O, so this link comes from elimination.

text.zh: 10 个碳、16 个 H、3 个不饱和度（C=O、C=C、环）都对上了。每个 ^{1}H 峰、^{13}C 峰、HSQC 峰和 HMBC 峰都有了归属。
text.en: Ten carbons, 16 H and three degrees of unsaturation (C=O, C=C, ring) all match. Every ^{1}H, ^{13}C, HSQC and HMBC peak is assigned.

rule.zh: 8 个 HMBC 峰都在 2–3 键以内，没有一个和结构矛盾。
rule.en: All eight HMBC peaks are within two or three bonds, and none contradicts the structure.

so.zh: 结构是 5-甲基-2-(丙-2-亚基)环己酮。

check.zh: 这些数据没有回答两件事：哪个异丙亚基甲基在 C=O 一侧（要 NOESY），以及手性中心 C1 的绝对构型（NMR 本身分不出对映体）。
check.en: Two questions remain open with these data: which isopropylidene methyl lies on the C=O side (that needs NOESY), and the absolute configuration at C1 (NMR alone cannot tell enantiomers apart).
